[attribute-prefix-word]
=== `@prefix-word` Prefix Word (For a List Item)

Word or phrase to be added to the beginning of each item in a list (for example, “`Step`”, “`Procedure`”).

#### Usage/Remarks
Any prefix word is in addition to and typically precedes any prefix characters (numbers, bullets). For example, a list type of “`order`” and a prefix word of “`Step`” would produce: “`Step1. aaaa`”, “`Step2. bbbb`”, “`Step3. cccc`”, etc. Note that typically, no white space follows the inserted word, i.e., “`Step`” rather than “`Step `”.
The standard exception to this order is the bulleted list, in which the prefix character would precede the prefix word—“`• Step`” rather than “` Step•`”.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-def-list,`<def-list>`>>, 
                  <<element-list,`<list>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The prefix word to be used for the list; for example, the word “`Step`” might be used to display a list numbered “`Step1.`”, “`Step2.`”, “`Step3.`”, etc.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
